Pelton, Basin Creek and Cottonwood (on the Stehekin valley trail Trapper uses) kept.

wa_mount_baker_boulder_glacier.why: Whole-mountain Baker list copied onto every Baker route. This route climbs the EAST side from the Boulder Ridge TH (FR 1131) to its own moraine camp ~5,500-5,700 ft. Hogsback/Kulshan/Upper Coleman/North Ridge/Colfax-Grant are the Heliotrope Ridge (NW side) Coleman-Deming camps; Sandy Camp and Railroad Grade/Morovitz are the Easton (south side, Schriebers Meadow) camps. Far side of the mountain from every way in. Leaves the route with no camps — correct: its real camp is not in the list and we never add.

wa_little_tahoma_cowlitz_ingraham_glacie.why: This route starts at PARADISE (south side) and traverses the Muir snowfield, Cowlitz and Ingraham glaciers; camp is on the Cowlitz/Ingraham or Cathedral Rocks (own prose). Summerland, the toe of the Fryingpan Glacier and Silver Springs Campground (White River, NE entrance) are all on the Fryingpan Creek / White River approach on the other side of Little Tahoma. Meany Crest kept only because namedInOwnProse=true (refused). Whitman Notch sits on the crest between the Fryingpan and Whitman glaciers on Little Tahoma's east side, reached from Meany Crest; the Paradise/Ingraham approach reaches the south/west face base at ~8,900 ft without passing it.

wa_mount_chaval_scramble.why: Snowking-area list propagated (Found Lake/Kindy crest carried by 5 routes). Kindy Ridge is Snowking's NE-ridge approach starting from Cascade River Road/FR 1570 on the far side of Snowking; Mount Chaval is across Illabot Creek to the south-west, approached from Illabot Creek Road (FR 16) via Jug Lake, the Illabot Creek bridge slope, or Bluff/Cliff Lake (https://www.summitpost.org/mount-chaval/152047 ; https://www.wta.org/go-hiking/trip-reports/tripreport-2000090402 ; https://trailcatjim.com/mt-chaval-via-west-ridge-northwest-face/). No Chaval approach uses Kindy Ridge. Slide Lake (Trail 635, up Otter Creek from Illabot Creek Rd ~mi 21) is by its own note the western gateway to SNOWKING, on the north side of Illabot Creek; Chaval's documented approaches (Jug Lake from the Arrow Creek switchback, Illabot Creek bridge, Bluff Lake) are on the south side and do not pass it (https://www.wta.org/go-hiking/hikes/slide-lake ; https://www.summitpost.org/snowking-mountain/152058). Medium because it shares the access road.

wa_tailgunner_peak_w_route.why: San Juan Campground is on the Index-Galena Road (North Fork Skykomish) and its own note calls it 'the nearest developed camp to the Spire Mountain roadhead' — copied from Spire Mountain (carry 3). Tailgunner is climbed from the Barclay Creek road (FR 6024) off US-2 near Baring, a separate drainage; the campground is also cut off by Index-Galena Rd closures (https://fs.usda.gov/recarea/mbs/recarea/?recid=17960). Gunn Basin and Barclay roadhead kept.
